method.users: 600 users, 2.0 per second. Each opens the app, types in an input, opens 3 pages by their tabs and clicks Apply, then stays idle. One user in 4 comes back 120.0 s after arriving: reloads its page, checks it and its input, and types again.
method.server: Uvicorn in its own process; session_ttl 24 h, so no session expires. 'hibernated' sets session_idle to 30.0 s, and the server's own timer saves the sessions; 'kept' sets None.
method.memory: Server RSS and the size of its saved sessions, every 1.0 s, until 90.0 s after the last request.
method.timings: HTTP time of each request, without a browser. return_ms is the reload of a returning user: in 'hibernated', it wakes the session from disk.
